name: Matan
source:
Automation girl. She is a hard-working troublemaker. She seems to like Lily and Rosario, especially Rosario.

She calls him "Rosario-sama."

"Matan's master is only Rosario!"

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official wesbite[/url]]
